title: Hidden Zillow listings created fake supply shock, raising NYC rents, lawsuit says
summary: Renters say hidden Zillow listings make it harder to afford living in New York City.
llm_summary: A lawsuit alleges that Zillow deliberately hid thousands of apartment listings from its public search tools, creating the illusion of a “supply shock” that pushed New York City rents higher. By restricting data that renters and developers rely on, the platform’s algorithmic choices may have distorted market signals and made affordable housing harder to find.
